Poisson decay is equivalent to sublinear cumulative upper spectral height
Canonical Suzuki gap has a center-eliminated entropy asymptotic

statusNote: Cutoffs zero and one are proved. The exact finite entropy identity and its quadratic mass-error majorant remain available. Lean now proves the fixed-endpoint drift law E_endpoint(N+1)-E_endpoint(N)=D_N-log((N+1)/N)E_mass(N), with D_N nonnegative and E_endpoint(2)=4 sqrt(2)-log(2)-4 strictly positive. The resulting telescoping formula reduces the sufficient quadratic certificate to a cumulative block inequality for signed mass-error work. That block bound, exact entropy domination, and every RH-forcing rigidity step remain open.
